description: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-3, comparing the sparsity before any gate, after a standard gate, and after an average gate. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” ranges from 0 to 20 and uses a linear scale, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 and also uses a linear scale, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, which remains consistently low near 0.0 across all layers; an orange dotted line with triangular markers representing the sparsity ratio after the gate, which starts at approximately 0.8 and decreases sharply to near 0.0 by layer 15 before slightly increasing again near layer 20; and a green dashed line with square markers representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate, which starts at approximately 0.8, decreases sharply to near 0.0 by layer 10, and then remains near zero with minor fluctuations until layer 20.
